definitions.gloss: shyness in unfamiliar places; feeling uncomfortable in new environments
definitions.explanation: A state of being shy, uncomfortable, or unable to relax in unfamiliar places or settings. Often used to describe children or pets.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{場|ば}{見知|みし}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
examples.english: Our child is very shy in unfamiliar places.

examples.japanese: {場|ば}{見知|みし}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{慣|な}れない→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧。
examples.english: I'm place-shy and have trouble adjusting to new environments.
The cat is place-shy and doesn't want to go outside.

notes:
{場|ば}{見知|みし}り describes shyness related to places, not people.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{人見知|ひとみし}り→人見知り：06622_hitomishiri⟧: shy with people (strangers)
- {場|ば}{見知|みし}り: shy in unfamiliar places

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {場|ば}{見知|みし}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be place-shy
- {場|ば}{見知|みし}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: to be very place-shy
- {場|ば}{見知|みし}り⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧: to not be place-shy

USAGE:
Frequently used when describing:
- Children at new schools or daycare
- Pets in new environments
- Adults who are uncomfortable traveling or in new social settings
